name: Quorum
hint: Three takes — the door needs p1 AND p2 held at the same moment, and the plates are 8 units apart (p1 x=5.5..7.5, p2 x=15.5..17.5) so one 0.8-wide body can never cover both. TAKE 1: walk right onto p1, stand, end the take. TAKE 2: Echo A now holds p1; walk past it onto p2, stand, end the take. Both plates are held during this take, but you are pinned on p2 — stepping off shuts the door 0.35s later and the doorway at x=26 is 10.7 units away (1.16s), so you cannot cash it in yourself. TAKE 3: Echoes A and B hold both plates, the door is open by about t=1.9s and you reach it at about t=2.6s. Run right through the doorway, continue to about x=31, then jump UP THROUGH the one-way grating at y=16.8 (a 3.2-unit rise, inside the 3.4 budget) and land on top of it. Run right along the grating to about x=32 and jump again — another 3.2 up — onto the ledge at y=13.6 whose left edge is x=33, then walk right into the exit at x=37. The ledge is 6.4 units above the floor, which no jump can reach, so the grating is the only way up; miss the second jump and the grating catches you.

dialogue.text: Two plates. One door. You have one body.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: So make three. Two to stand still, one to leave.
The grating past the door only holds from below. Jump up through it.
